BrochureContent.Content:
Property Partners Mulholland are delighted to offer for sale this truly unique detached residence, set on a generous 1.24-acre site in an idyllic rural location. The property enjoys the peace and tranquility of the beautiful surrounding countryside, while being conveniently located just 3 km from Collooney and approximately 15 km from Sligo town.

Set on a wonderful private site, this distinctive property offers a wealth of additional accommodation and facilities, including a separate one-bedroom chalet, a garden room and large three-car carport. The mature gardens provide a peaceful and private setting, with beautiful lawns, established trees and extensive grounds creating an ideal environment for outdoor relaxation and enjoyment.

The main residence has a bright and welcoming interior, with extensive glazing bringing the surrounding greenery into many of the principal rooms. The accommodation includes an entrance porch, hallway, kitchen / dining room, pantry, spacious living room, home office, guest WC, four bedrooms and bathroom. In addition, a substantial extension offers excellent potential for further accommodation. With its own separate entrance and direct access to the main residence, this versatile space could readily lend itself to additional living accommodation.

The property also benefits from a wonderful, recently constructed, self-contained one-bedroom chalet. There is also a large garden room featuring extensive glazing and a solid fuel stove, offering a versatile additional space with a variety of potential uses. A large three-car carport and garden store complete the extensive ancillary accommodation.

The property has been upgraded and very well maintained, and benefits from a newly installed septic tank / treatment system, an energy-efficient condensing 'combi' oil boiler, extensive insulation, and upgraded double-glazed windows throughout. This represents a terrific opportunity to acquire a truly individual property offering generous accommodation, excellent ancillary facilities and a wonderful private rural setting.
